discovery.decisionRationale: No authoritative, complete, downloadable 3D Miami model with verified redistribution rights was found. Generate deterministic geometry from checksum-pinned public-domain and ODbL geospatial inputs; import landmarks only after exact per-asset license approval.

sources.author: Overture Maps Foundation and upstream contributors
sources.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Overture Maps Foundation; retain all per-source attribution
sources.verticalDatum: not-applicable for footprints; source height semantics must be validated
sources.coverage: Clip building and building_part features to declared Miami metro bounds
sources.blocker: Acquire exact GeoParquet partitions, preserve upstream attribution and GERS IDs, validate height semantics, and checksum the clipped derivative database.

sources.publisher: Miami-Dade County Information Technology Department and Office of Resilience
sources.author: Miami-Dade County
sources.attribution: Miami-Dade County Information Technology Department; Office of Resilience
sources.coverage: Miami-Dade County building footprints within and outside the Urban Development Boundary
sources.blocker: The public service publishes copyright attribution but no explicit redistribution license. Obtain written reuse approval and a versioned bulk export before conflation.

sources.author: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program
sources.verticalDatum: per-work-unit; normalize to NAVD88 before ellipsoid conversion
sources.coverage: All current 1 m DEM and source-resolution work units intersecting metro bounds
sources.blocker: Resolve exact WESM work-unit URLs, dates, quality levels, CRS, vertical datum, and hashes at acquisition time.

sources.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
sources.author: NOAA/NOS/NCEI
sources.attribution: NOAA NCEI, 2018, Biscayne Bay S200, doi:10.7289/V5GM85N8
sources.blocker: Acquire the exact NetCDF, record its hash, and convert MLLW to the package NAVD88/ellipsoid contract using pinned VDatum evidence. Data must be labeled not for navigation.

sources.author: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program
sources.attribution: USDA Farm Service Agency, National Agriculture Imagery Program
sources.coverage: Select all current Florida quarter-quadrangles intersecting metro bounds
sources.blocker: Select exact Florida artifacts and vintage, verify cloud/color/GSD fitness, and record delivery hashes before use.

sources.author: Overture Maps Foundation and upstream contributors
sources.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Overture Maps Foundation; retain transportation-theme attribution
sources.coverage: Roads, connectors, causeways, rail, and transportation segments in metro bounds
sources.blocker: Acquire exact partitions, preserve source lineage and NOTICE data, and checksum the clipped road database.

sources.author: Overture Maps Foundation and upstream contributors
sources.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Overture Maps Foundation; retain base-theme attribution
sources.coverage: Biscayne Bay, Atlantic coastline, Miami River, canals, barrier islands, beaches, and harbor edges
sources.blocker: Acquire exact base-theme partitions and checksum the clipped land/water derivative before shoreline conflation.

sources.author: Overture Maps Foundation and upstream contributors
sources.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Overture Maps Foundation; retain base-theme attribution
sources.coverage: Parks, beaches, mangrove/wooded land use, and vegetation-supporting extents in metro bounds
sources.blocker: Acquire exact base-theme partitions, supplement hero-zone palms from an approved inventory or deterministic placement rules, and checksum the derivative.

sources.publisher: Miami-Dade County Communications and Information Technology
sources.author: Miami-Dade County GIS
sources.originalCrs: delivery-specific; likely Florida East State Plane
sources.coverage: County LAS, DEM, mass points, and orthophotography are available by request, potentially for a fee
sources.blocker: Request quote, metadata, exact delivery terms, redistribution grant, CRS/datum, capture date, resolution, and sample before purchase.

rejectedCandidates.reason: Cannot be extracted and republished as an immutable offline Miami package; forbidden from source lineage.
Rendered reference service has empty license metadata and is not an approved source for repackaged geometry or textures.
Pinned Overture themes already incorporate and attribute OSM while providing GERS IDs; avoid duplicate geometry unless a required tag is missing.
No landmark model may enter the build without exact author, license, source URL, redistribution permission, and content hash.
